calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, s.region, s.store_id>=900 AS pseudo, f.channel_code, f.staff_purchase_flag, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_lines, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) calc_gross, sum(f.net_amount) net, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(DISTINCT s.valid_from) vf
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.store_key, s.region, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.open_date, s.close_date, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, count(*) n, sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) outside, sum(f.gross_amount) g
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND (s.region='West' OR s.store_id>=900 OR s.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE valid_from>DATE '2024-01-01' AND valid_from<DATE '2025-01-01') OR f.sale_date NOT BETWEEN s.valid_from AND s.valid_to)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT count(*) n, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) dist_rl, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) dist_id, count(*) FILTER (WHERE etl_loaded_at IS NULL) nl, min(etl_loaded_at), max(etl_loaded_at), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) dl, sum(CASE WHEN store_key IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullstore, sum(CASE WHEN gross_amount<0 OR quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) neg
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'

calls.statement:
SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, f.sale_date >= DATE '2024-09-01' AS from_sep1, f.vat_rate, p.vat_class, count(*) n, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, sum(round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) calc, sum(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism, sum(f.gross_amount - round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2)) diff
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH d AS (SELECT calendar_date FROM dim_date WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'),
x AS (SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT store_key) stores, sum(gross_amount) g FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, x.n, x.stores, x.g FROM d LEFT JOIN x ON x.sale_date=d.calendar_date WHERE x.n IS NULL OR x.n < 1000 OR x.stores < 40 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.channel_code, CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) = f.sale_date AS same_day, CAST((f.sale_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Helsinki' AS DATE) = f.sale_date AS same_local, count(*) n, sum(gross_amount) g, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' OR CAST(f.sale_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT s.region,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-08-31' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_aug_2024,
  sum(CASE WHEN f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-09-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' THEN f.gross_amount ELSE 0 END) AS gross_sales_incl_vat_sep_2024
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
  AND s.store_id <> 999
GROUP BY s.region
ORDER BY s.region
